test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Several key policies have been introduced by the government to promote renewable energy.

options.text: The government has introduced several key policies to promote renewable energy.
The government introduces several key policies to promote renewable energy.
The government introduced several key policies to promote renewable energy.
The government is introducing several key policies to promote renewable energy.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. The government has introduced several key policies to promote renewable energy .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, where the subject (government) is receiving the action.
 
• To convert it into the **active voice**, the subject (government) must perform the action.
 
• The correct structure for the active voice sentence is: **Subject + has/have + past participle + object.**
 
• Option 1 correctly converts the sentence into the active voice, maintaining the tense and meaning.

Correct sentence: *The government has introduced several key policies to promote renewable energy*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Object + has/have + been + past participle + by + subject.
 
• **Example:** Several key policies have been introduced by the government.
 
• **Usage:** Focuses on the action or object receiving the action rather than the performer.
 
 
 
• **Active Voice:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + has/have + past participle + object.
 
• **Example:** The government has introduced several key policies to promote renewable energy.
 
• **Usage:** Focuses on the performer of the action.
